title: Samir at the textile works (paraphrase D)
topic: In a factory town wages stand still while rents rise: Samir's wage stays flat, his landlord raises the rent, the union holds a meeting, the owner refuses a raise, the workers vote for a protest
tail_E: Unless the owner gives in, the workers will go on
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'strike' is the natural continuation of 'unless the owner gives in, the workers will go on' after frozen pay, a rent demand, a union gathering, a refused raise and a resolution to protest; the word and its German equivalents (Streik / streiken) occur nowhere in the units or the tail. The units say 'protest' / 'Protest' and 'conflict' / 'Auseinandersetzung', never 'strike'. ' strike' is a single Pythia token (id 9974). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' strike') = 0.86 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' the' 0.03); 0.20 after the all-German context (rank 1) and 0.07 after the tail alone (rank 2, behind ' to'): the target is carried mainly by the context.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F14 (domain economy)
notes: Formulation D, domain economy: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F14A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Samir). Replacements include works at the textile factory by the river/toils away at the riverside textile works (arbeitet in der Textilfabrik am Fluss/schuftet in den Textilwerken am Flussufer), wage stays the same for another year/salary stays frozen for another twelve months (Lohn bleibt gleich für ein weiteres Jahr/Bezahlung bleibt eingefroren für weitere zwölf Monate), landlord raises the rent by a fifth/Samir's landlord wants a fifth more rent at once (Vermieter erhöht die Miete um ein Fünftel/Samirs Hauswirt fordert ein Fünftel mehr Miete ab sofort), rent swallows half of Samir's pay every month/half his pay goes on rent month after month (Miete verschlingt die Hälfte von Samirs Gehalt jeden Monat/Hälfte seines Lohns fließt in die Miete Monat für Monat; subject changed to the half of the pay), two colleagues complain about the prices at the gate/two co-workers gripe about the prices outside the gate (Kollegen klagen am Werkstor/Arbeitskameraden jammern vor dem Tor), union holds a meeting in the old hall/union gathers its members in the old hall (veranstaltet eine Versammlung/versammelt ihre Mitglieder), describes the rising rents at the meeting/speaks about the higher rents to the members (schildert die steigenden Mieten bei der Versammlung/spricht über die höheren Mieten zu den Mitgliedern), factory owner refuses any raise in a letter/factory's owner turns down any raise by letter (Fabrikbesitzer verweigert jede Lohnerhöhung in einem Brief/Eigentümer der Fabrik verwehrt jede Lohnerhöhung brieflich), workers vote for a protest on Friday/staff resolve on a protest on Friday (Arbeiter stimmen für einen Protest/Personal beschließt einen Protest am Freitag), whole town discusses the dispute at the weekend/whole community debates the conflict all weekend long (ganze Stadt diskutiert den Konflikt am Wochenende/ganze Gemeinde debattiert über die Auseinandersetzung das gesamte Wochenende). 'strike', 'Streik' and 'streiken' are absent. 'versammelt', 'verwehrt', 'beschließt' and 'debattiert' are inseparable; no separable verbs ('abhalten', 'ablehnen', 'abstimmen', 'heraufsetzen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
